onset_note: Approximate first clear thunder rise measured from waveform envelopes; includes only 60–100 ms of lead-in, not a distance delay. Natural rolls have a broad onset.
schedule: clipStartDsp = strikeDsp + desiredAcousticDelaySeconds - cue.onsetSeconds / pitch. Clamp scheduling to >= dspTime + 0.05 seconds if late; keep pitch=1 for precise timing. Trigger once per lightning strike group, not per flicker.
gain_note: All WAVs are already conservatively leveled. Suggested gain is an additional art-direction starting point; rainSource.volume=1.0.
